name: auryn-typescript
summary: TypeScript/JavaScript language plugin for Auryn: one fast tree-sitter engine over the whole JS/TS family (.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs), extracting classes/interfaces/enums/type-aliases/functions/methods/params, the ES-module import graph, and calls. A deep tsserver/TS-compiler pass (resolved types, cross-module calls) is the planned second phase.
